text: (1) Scanned copy of valid passport information page; (2) notarized certificate of the highest academic qualification. If the applicant is a current student, he/she must submit a pre-graduation certificate or study certificate issued by his/her school; (3) Transcripts of all courses at the highest level of education (Chinese/English transcripts can be provided; if they are in languages other than English, English translations and notarization are required); (4) certificate photo (blue background 2 inch bareheaded photo); (5) The Financial Guarantee Letter of Fujian Medical University for International Students and the scanned copy of the guarantee materials to prove the financial sources of personal financial resources or family financial support, government funding, financial guarantor sponsorship, etc.; (6) The scanned copy of the original "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners", which is printed by the Chinese health and quarantine department and must be filled in Chinese or English; (7) Proof of language ability; (8) Applicants under the age of 18 must provide the original and photocopy of the power of attorney certified by the Chinese embassy or consulate in the country of origin. ★ The above materials will not be returned regardless of whether they are accepted or not. ★ The above forms can be downloaded from the website of Overseas Education College of Fujian Medical University.
